answer: Problem: sybil farms flood sortition with disposable clones that mirror honest votes. Mechanism: each new seat must till a reputation garden for 3 stamped epochs, then pass a river of 11 peer rechecks of public actions before any mesa-ranked panel counts its ballot. Cost: forging 30 clones burns ~15h stamp CPU plus 30 locked soil deposits. Verification: auditors recompute garden fertility from stamps and eject any identity whose river recheck mismatches by more than one action. Failure: two failed rechecks burn the deposit and freeze that seat for 3 epochs.
